title: Lost Cities
field: Humanities and social sciences (urban history and archaeology of lost cities)
about: The Gerda Henkel Foundation's Lost Cities special programme invites research groups of at least two postdoctoral scholars in the humanities or social sciences to apply. The next deadline is 19 May 2027, with digital applications in English or German.
requirements: Postdoctoral researchers based at a university in the humanities or social sciences
Doctoral candidates may not apply on their own
Individual applications are not accepted; projects need a team of at least two scholars
Digital application in English or German
card_alt: Card for Lost Cities, a research programme of the Gerda Henkel Foundation for postdoctoral teams; application deadline 19 May 2027. The photo is a generic city skyline over a river at sunset and does not show a location of the programme.
